description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractComposite` used as a base for composite validation rules within a validation framework. It handles construction of rule instances and their validation logic, and is intended to be extended by specific composite rule implementations.

classes.name: AbstractComposite
classes.description: An abstract class for composite validation rules that aggregate multiple Rule instances and perform validation based on them.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the composite rule with a variable number of Rule objects.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on input by instantiating rule classes with their constructor parameters and delegating validation to the specific composite rule implementation.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Abstract method to return the class name of the specific composite rule.
